openFindings.title: A checked completion criterion does not reproduce
A missing prompt-card guard skips its check with no message
A relayout that fails outside its guarded block exits 2 with a raw engine error the apply workflow has no rule for
A sibling link that resolves back inside the tree is refused with the wrong reason
A Skilled engine test still names its overlay folder barter-overlays
An in-tree overlayDir that links outside the repository skips the outside-repository refusal
Generic LAYOUT guidance sends root/skilled lines to relayout in the presentation's next-step rows and the status workflow
Git write gate fails open and silently through its CLI entrypoint
layoutLinks paths escape the tree root unvalidated, and the relayout rollback now writes through them
No test covers the branch where the relayout rollback itself fails or the backup cannot be removed
overlays/README.md does not document that the commit hook refuses a vendored commit when no manifest is found
Phase 007 summary says the ai-speckit fix reaches origin with phase 008, which pushed nothing in ai-speckit
Phase 008 summary says its folder is uncommitted, in the commit that commits it
The commit gate can resolve the tree one level too deep and then report a missing engine instead of a missing manifest
The committed overlay manifest pins an absolute local checkout path
The docs attribute the outside-repository refusal to a pre-commit check that never prints it
The engine's commit check allows every unowned vendored change when git runs it from a hook in a linked worktree, and no test runs pre-commit under that environment
openFindings.description: Under a hook-exported GIT_DIR, overlay-engine pre-commit returns allow for a staged unowned vendored change in a tree below the git top level, and no test covers that environment for pre-commit

openFindings.title: The packet's last completion criterion understates the phase count
The pinned-blob reader passes a manifest value to git without --end-of-options
The restore-failed relayout line and references/overlays.md say the kept backup holds every moved copy, but the backup skips token-named files
The three staged-list scans in pre-commit disagree on which change types they see
